A malicious petition or proceeding to adjudicate a person an insolvent to declare a person lunatic or to wind up a company, to make action against legal practioner under the Lagal Practitioners Act, maliciously procuring arrest or attachment in execution of a decree or before judgment, order or injunction or appointment of receiver, arrest of a ship, search of the plaintiff’s premises, arrest of a person by police
